scripts-descriptions.lint: woocommerce/* is excluded because that directory holds unmodified WooCommerce core template overrides copied from the plugin for structural overriding only -- they were never authored to WordPress Coding Standards and are not this theme's code. The trailing /* anchors the match to that directory only (phpcs --ignore matches as an unanchored substring, so a bare 'woocommerce' would also exclude inc/woocommerce.php, a theme-authored file). Excluding the directory keeps the gate scoped to code this theme actually owns.
